verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents its own isolated execution environments: "Hyperbrowser Sandboxes" that run commands via sandbox.exec, and cloud browser sessions described as "isolated browser instances." These give real sandbox isolation, not just a dry-run. The evidence does not show a test or staging mode, such as test API keys or separate non-production data, that keeps testing away from production data. missing for 10: documented test/staging mode or test credentials separated from production data, guidance on isolating test runs from production accounts/data, independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Hyperbrowser Sandboxes are the fastest sandboxes with less than 50ms startup time.
Sessions are isolated browser instances running in the cloud that you can control programmatically.
Set up the Hyperbrowser CLI (`hx`) and/or the SDKs to start working with sandboxes.
